members.role: the page lands on its axes; nothing projected is drawn yet
the actuals draw on their own words, the last actual landing on the number the sentence says
the evidence is WRITTEN - the figures the claim turns on, off their own data, so the page is read before anything is projected
about ten to fourteen seconds on, on the projection's word, T16's dashed unbloomed continuation draws from the last actual, tagged with its label and tier

does: The actuals draw and are written on their words and the page holds ten to fourteen seconds, then on the projection's word a dashed, unbloomed continuation draws from the last actual, tagged as an estimate with its tier.

use_when.act: COMPARES (projecting) - the evidence, then the conditional future (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R26)
use_when.shape: a series of actuals (+ named averages), then ONE sourced projected point from the last actual
use_when.use: hold the evidence ~10-14 s, then a projection in a visibly new grammar ('Last year: a hundred and twenty-one billion. This year they're tracking toward a hundred and fifty.')
use_when.dont: the projection arrives before the evidence is read (STK held ~10-14 s); a projection with no label or tier (E77, refused); a projection its sources give as a RANGE (recipe:estimate-opens-as-a-wedge is the form)
